setLimit(int $limit)

Sets how many trusted proxies are in front of the application.

In headers with comma-separated values (e.g. X-Forwarded-For, or multiple Forwarded: entries) the value is taken counting from the end of the list: 1 (default) uses the last entry (appended by the closest proxy), 2 the second to last, and so on. If the limit is greater than the number of entries, the first one is used. This prevents clients from spoofing values at the beginning of the list.

Parameters

int $limit
